info.title: LIS Cattle API
info.description: API for cattle holdings, registrations and submission processing.

post.description: Creates a bundle of cattle registrations for asynchronous validation and processing.
Validates the cattle registration bundle identified by its unique ID.

get.summary: Get a user's details and associated CPHs
get.description: Retrieves a user's details and the CPHs they are associated with from the keeper data service, by identity provider subject. The associations are those captured when the user last signed in.

post.summary: Create or refresh a user account
post.description: Ensures a user account exists in the keeper data service for the supplied identity provider claims (sub, email, given_name, family_name) and returns the user's details and associated CPHs. An existing account (matched by subject, or by an email with no subject yet) is refreshed; otherwise one is created. Returns 409 when the email belongs to a different account and 503 when the keeper data service is temporarily unavailable.
